definitions.explanation: The visual rear portion of a picture, photograph, or scene — what lies behind the main subject.
The circumstances, history, or context underlying an event, decision, or person. Often used to explain why something happened.

notes:
Composed of {背|はい} (back) + {景|けい} (scene). Covers both literal visual backgrounds and figurative contextual backgrounds. The figurative sense is very common in journalism and analysis.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背景|はいけい}⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧: background image
- {背景|はいけい}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: background color
- {背景|はいけい}⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧: background music (often abbreviated BGM)
- {背景|はいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to investigate the background
- {背景|はいけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: behind ~ lies
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}{的|てき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧{背景|はいけい}: social background; social context
- ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧{背景|はいけい}: family background

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{背後|はいご}→背後：18212_haigo⟧: behind; rear — physical position, or a hidden actor pulling strings
- ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧: behind the scenes; reverse side — emphasizes what is hidden
- ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: situation — the current state, not the prior context
